description: European corn borer projects monitor Bt resistance across Minnesota, the U.S., and Canada. Corn rootworm projects evaluate Bt traits, insecticides, seed treatments, larval competition, and cold tolerance. Additional work addresses invasive Old World bollworm risk, statewide pest surveillance, and reduced neonicotinoid use.
partners: USDA Agriculture and Food Research Initiative
Minnesota Corn Research and Promotion Council
Minnesota Invasive Terrestrial Plants and Pests Center (MITPPC)
Minnesota Agricultural Experiment Station, Rapid Agricultural Response Fund Program
